body_en: Lab work needs method: question, plan, observe, record, conclude. Never fake data. Report errors honestly. Read graphs slowly — the lines and numbers matter. Share findings so others can test them.
body_zh: 实验要方法：提问、计划、观察、记录、结论。绝不造假数据，诚实报错。慢慢读图——线条与数字很重要。分享发现，让别人能复验。
